description: This file is the main entry point for a React application. It sets up rendering of the root React component into the DOM element with id 'root', and wraps the application in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems during development.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React app.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element into the DOM at the specified root.
